rules.statement: The proper party to be sued for an action under section 146 of the Customs Ordinance is the Attorney-General, not a Collector of Customs.
rules.supporting_quote: "I would, therefore, dismiss the appeal with costs. The Attorney-General is the proper person to be sued either in an action under section 146 for declaration of title .to goods released on security or in an action falling outside section 146-if such an action is available-for declaration of title and restitution of goods condemned under that section."
